title: Nobody's home.
subject: PNN: A plate of treats. A porch full of silence. A study on why nobody answers.
preheader: Homemade treats, the doorbell effect, and the party you were not invited to. Statistics included.

featuredCase.teaser: **The Tightie Whities brought the treats. The neighborhood brought the porch light, switched off.** Multiple plates, multiple doors, and one overheard review of the night. Clueso has the doorstep file. *Whether anyone ever took a plate is now a separate investigation.*

items.text: **Neighbors who have stood very still while someone rang the bell.** The remaining 17% were 'in the shower,' 'asleep,' or 'a very quiet couch.'
**Porch lights that mysteriously go dark at 7:01 PM.** Experts call this 'the sunset effect.' Residents call it 'nothing to see here.'
**Doorbells that, when rung, are answered by a dog.** The dog is no help. The dog wants the plate.
**Average time a person will hold their breath behind a door.** Record: 44. The door was not impressed.

**Parties that you were not invited to, as reported by you.** Researchers note that the party is always 'the best one all year.' It is also always 'across town.' PNN has checked. **It is rarely a party.**
**Plates of treats safely accepted by a neighbor in a documented trial.** The neighbor is believed to be 'a very nice person.' PNN has requested an interview. The neighbor's lights are off.
